This has been muted on branch 9.1

**Mute Reasons:**
- [9.1] 3 failures in test test (0.7% fail rate in 401 executions)

**Build Scans:**
- [elasticsearch-periodic-platform-support #10528 / oraclelinux-8_platform-support-unix](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/virkf6uf2xtug)
- [elasticsearch-pull-request #90270 / part-3](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/yghr4nmroloaq)
- [elasticsearch-intake #27985 / part3](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/jhje7qe3wlnea)

I've spent some time in trying to reproduce this failure. Using the repro line from the CI failures didn't bring any success. Also, this was on 9.1

So, I went back to `main` because it was easier for me to experiment and I added the following query to `lookup-join.csv-spec`:

```
specialTestFromGenerativeIT
from sample_d*,languages_mixed_numerics,apps
| rename language_code_byte as language_code
| lookup join languages_lookup on language_code
| rename id as language_code
| lookup join languages_lookup on language_code
| sort language_code_short DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC NULLS LAST, language_name
;

@timestamp:unsupported|client_ip:unsupported|event_duration:l| language_code:i | language_code_double:d | language_code_float:d  |language_code_half_float:d|language_code_integer:i| language_code_long:l |language_code_scaled_float:d|language_code_short:i|       message:keyword       |     name:keyword      |    version:version    | language_name:keyword 
null           |null           |null           |null           |32767.0               |32767.0               |32768.0                 |32767                |32767               |32767.0                   |32767              |null                 |null           |null           |null           
null           |null           |null           |null           |128.0                 |128.0                 |128.0                   |128                  |128                 |128.0                     |128                |null                 |null           |null           |null
;
```

Then I ran the test in series of 10 iterations like so:

`gradlew :x-pack:plugin:esql:qa:server:multi-node:javaRestTest --tests "org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.qa.multi_node.EsqlSpecIT" -Dtests.method="*SpecialTestFromGenerativeIT*" -Dtests.iters=10`

Apart from the tests that fail because the order of the results is not right (the test above returns many more rows, but I added in this comment only two lines; I don't think it's relevant how many rows are returned), there are failures as reported in the original issue.
